topics.correction: `key_terms`માં 'ચોરો — ગામ કે મંદિર પાસેનો જાહેર ઓટલો, બેસવાની જગ્યા' એમ, વપરાયાના સ્થળે જ, ગ્લોસ કરવો, જેથી 'ચોર' (thief) સાથે ગૂંચવણ ન થાય.

chapter_level: The five quoted પદ-fragments and their છાપ across M2.S2.T3, M2.S2.T4 and M4.S4.T7 carry archaic word-forms — 'નરસૈયો', 'છોડાવિયો', 'તુજ', 'ધેન' — that a Hindi/English-medium reader may read as spelling errors; none may ever be corrected or modernised in any authored field, only glossed as the old poetic form.

This whole chapter is the profile's own worked example of avoid-gate 11 (a printed ચમત્કાર asserted or debunked) — the miracle-of-speech (M1.S1.T1), the 'જાણે ચમત્કાર' sadhana (M1.S1.T2), the શામળશા-શેઠ hundi legend (M3.S3.T5) and the mameru legend (M3.S3.T6) must all stay reported exactly the way the chapter hedges them ('કહેવાય છે', 'જાણે', 'એ કથા/લોકકથા જાણીતી છે') — a single throughline, not four unrelated flags.

Every legend in this chapter turns on envy or social slight (M3.S3.T5's ઈર્ષ્યાળુ યાત્રાળુઓ, M3.S3.T6's ઈર્ષ્યાથી બળતા દીવાન, M4.S4.T7's ઊંચનીચનો ભેદ) and each invites a tacked-on બોધ about jealousy or equality (gate 12) — Agent 12 should expect this pull on all three topics, not treat it as a one-off risk.
